ground_tile: Square ground tile, 2 x 2 m and about 4 cm thick: patchy grass and dry dirt with a trail of cat paw prints pressed into it. It must tile seamlessly: flat straight edges, nothing sticks out past the square.
road_tile: Square road tile, 2 x 2 m and 10 cm thick: cracked asphalt with a painted yellow fish-shaped lane marking in the middle and a few cracks. Flat straight edges so tiles line up.
fence_broken: Broken wooden garden fence section, 2 m long and 1.1 m tall: two posts, two rails, pickets whose tops are cut into two pointed cat ears, two pickets snapped short, one hanging crooked from a single nail.
tombstone_cat: Cat-shaped tombstone: a stone slab 0.7 m wide and 1.1 m tall whose top has two pointed cat ears, a paw print carved into the front, standing on a low stone base with a small puddle of glowing green goo.
dead_tree: Dead leafless tree about 2.5 m tall: a gnarled trunk with a few bare crooked branches, broken roots at the base, and a red ball of yarn hanging from one branch on a string.
cardboard_barricade: Barricade of stacked cardboard boxes, 1.8 m wide and 1.2 m tall, with taped seams and dented corners; a zombie cat hides in the top box with only its pointed ears and two glowing green eyes peeking out.
toxic_can: Giant opened cat-food tin, about 1 m tall, the round lid peeled back and standing up; a purple label with a fish picture; glowing green toxic goo bubbling inside and spilling over the rim into puddles on the ground.
street_lamp: Street lamp 3.2 m tall: a thin metal pole on a round base, a curved arm at the top holding a lantern shaped like a fish that glows warm yellow, and a band of rust low on the pole.
bones_pile: Small pile of three fish skeletons lying flat on the ground, about 0.66 m across: each with a skull, a spine, thin ribs and a tail fin.
scratch_post_ruin: Ruined cat scratching post about 1.15 m tall: a sisal-rope-wrapped pole between a square carpeted base and a tilted square top platform, the carpet torn and the rope frayed, a cracked side shelf.
zombie_cat: Zombie cat character standing upright on two legs like a person, about 1 m tall: a big round head with big pink-lined ears, green eyes, a white muzzle, belly and paws, grey-green fur, a red collar with a brass bell, arms hanging at its sides, the tail curling up behind. It is a character, so it has a face.
